prompt: Objective: respond to a new rival in a ride-hailing city. What you've learned: share fell from 60% to 45%. Latest finding: the losses are concentrated in late-night trips, where the rival pays drivers more. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare our app ratings with the rival's
options.feedback: Secondary: the losses line up with driver pay at night.

options.text: Estimate the cost of matching the rival's driver pay everywhere
options.feedback: That jumps to a costly fix, and the problem is only late at night.

options.text: Ask the interviewer which hours to focus on
options.feedback: The finding already says: late nights. Drive the case.

options.text: Ask the interviewer for late-night driver supply and wait times
options.feedback: Right. Losses are concentrated where the rival pays drivers more, so night driver supply is next.

explanation: Losses are concentrated in late-night trips, where the rival pays drivers more. Check driver supply and wait times at night.
